## C2 — What QL Is [REWRITTEN rev-7; derivation paragraph DEEPENED rev-10 — PROPOSED]

> Quaternal Logic is a logic of positions, not propositions. Classical logic asks whether statements are true; QL asks where an act of knowing *stands* — at its ground, its definition, its operation, its pattern, its context, or its synthesis — and what each station demands before the next can be honest.
>
> Its seed is a single pair, 0/1 — and the choice that determines everything is upstream of the pair: it is how the unit itself is read. Ordinary binary constitutes its one as a bare quantity — defined by exclusion from its own negation, carrying −1 silently within it. Mathematics already holds this fork: the whole numbers open at 1 — a bare first with no prior; the natural numbers open at 0, making 1 the successor of none, rooted before it is number. The two routes of two are not invented here — they are a decision already written into how counting starts. Two bare ones can only cancel; difference has nowhere to go but opposition. QL reads its unit as the natural-number one: the 0/1-one that carries its ground alongside its number, so neither term in the pair is the other's negation. The two terms remain distinct without becoming each other's enemies, and so are free to meet. Let the pair relate to itself, and four further terms arise — 00, 01, 10, 11 — the complete field of how 0 and 1 can be combined. The original pair persists alongside the four it generates, and the field completes at six. This is the clean giving beneath the six positions: 2 + 4, the pair and its self-relation, the sixfold field that QL makes usable. The first reading is not opposed by the second — it is the second with the ground forgotten. Restore the 0 to the unit and the cancelling pair becomes generative. We take non-duality and not only run with it; we define how it runs.
>
> Each position carries its inverse, and the whole structure is holographic — every position contains the entire sixfold in its own register, the way each fragment of a hologram carries the full image. This is why the logic can travel: a cause, a psyche, a sentence, a scale, a civilisation — wherever something becomes itself through stages, the sixfold is already operating, and QL gives it a name.
>
> Its roots are Jungian as much as mathematical. Jung mapped the psyche as four functions and two attitudes; with Pauli he went further, holding that number itself is archetypal — "the most primitive element of order in the human mind" and the most fundamental structure of physical reality, one order on both sides of the mind–matter line. QL takes that inheritance seriously enough to formalise it: the first six numbers treated not as counts but as characters — each an "abstract pattern of rhythmical behaviour," in von Franz's phrase — composed into a logic that holds contradiction without collapsing, and completes by returning: the sixth step folding back into the ground, enriched. We take non-duality and not only run with it; we define how it runs.
